7200: Sit tall on a bench or chair with the band just above your knees.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press your knees out against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
7201: Lie on your back with the band around your feet or anchored behind your head.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs together toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
7202: Stand with the band under your feet or around your thighs, feet together.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7203: Place the band around your thighs and stand with feet hip-width.
Sit into a squat and stay low.
Step one foot out to the side against the band.
Bring the other foot in to follow.
Take several steps, then return the other way.
7204: Place the band around your ankles and stand tall on one leg.
Hold a wall or rail for balance if needed.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Kick the other leg back, squeezing the glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7205: Place the band above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Land softly, absorbing into the next squat.
Keep your knees pressing out against the band.
7206: Put the band around your thighs and stand tall.
Step one foot out to the side.
Stand up and bring your feet together.
Keep the knees from caving in.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7207: Stand in front of a bench, band under your front foot and held at your shoulders.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7208: Start on hands and knees with the band around your foot and hands.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7209: Start on hands and knees with the band around your thighs or foot.
Lift one leg out to the side with a bent knee.
Sweep it in a half circle, back and up.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7210: Place the band above your knees and get into a high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
7211: Lie face down with the band around your ankles.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Open your legs out against the band.
Bring them back together and lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
7212: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, band around your feet.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your opposite elbow toward that knee.
Extend the other leg against the band.
7213: Lie on your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your ribs.
Rest the forearm on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower it slowly back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
7216: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.
7217: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
7228: Grab the rings with a wide overhand grip and hang with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the rings, driving elbows down and out.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
7229: Start in a high plank with a kettlebell beside one hand.
Spread your feet wide for balance.
Grab the kettlebell and slide it across under your body.
Place it down on the other side.
Keep your hips level and repeat in the other direction.
7230: Place two kettlebells on the floor between your wide stance.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grab both handles.
Row one kettlebell to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it and row the other side.
Keep your hips and shoulders square.
7231: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.
7232: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Bring them forward and up again in a circle.
Reverse the direction after several reps.
7233: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
7234: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
7235: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7237: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it with your thumbs under your fingers.
Hinge down, brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out with hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar under control by hinging at the hips first.
7251: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
7252: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Complete your reps and switch sides.
7255: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.
7263: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.
7274: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.
7275: Set your feet in the straps and place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold without letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.
7276: Stand wide with a bottle on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Keep your back flat and grip a bottle in each hand.
Row one bottle up to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it, then row with the other side.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides.
7277: Kneel with a band anchored low in front and looped around your hips.
Start with your hips back and chest up.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes hard.
7278: Hold the straps and lean back with straight arms.
Sit your hips back and drop your chest between your arms.
Feel the stretch along the sides of your back.
7279: Hold the straps with arms extended and sink into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
As you rise, pull the straps toward your chest.
Lower your arms and sit back into the next squat.
7281: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it low and loop it on one foot.
Stand tall holding something for balance.
Kick the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
7282: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Sit into a slight squat with feet hip width apart.
Step sideways, keeping tension in the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the band go slack.
Walk back the other way to even it out.
7287: Stand inside the trap bar and hold it at shoulder height with a neutral grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause, then lower to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
7294: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Take a breath in with a neutral spine.
Exhale, tilting your pelvis so your lower back presses into the floor.
